messages:
aj: Quick pulse — we're targeting deprecation of /api/v1/auth next quarter. Need owners for SDKs, Dedicated, Private deploys, and canary plan. Proposed deprecation date: 2025-04-01. Who can own migration readiness + list blockers? @mia @sam ?

mia: on SDK/mobile. SDK 2.0 PR is open (#4523). ETA for release: 2025-03-15. Blocker: token format change causing a couple of parsing regressions in iOS unit tests. :eyes:

sam: Private deployments here — we'll add a runtime flag to toggle v1 fallback. Patch in internal repo infra/flags#78. Plan to ship flag + migration script week of Mar 17. Main concern: hosted proxies that rewrite Authorization header.

olivia: Can we run a 48h canary on one Dedicated cluster before cutover? Need auth.latency, 5xx rate, and token-fail metrics. I can own dashboards if someone schedules the canary.

aj: @olivia yes please own the canary. @deploy-bot can you schedule a canary on dedicated-01 2025-03-25 00:00 UTC for 48h?

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: cluster=dedicated-01, service=auth, variant=v2-auth, fallback=off. Window=2025-03-25T00:00Z -> 2025-03-27T00:00Z. Reminder: oncall notified 24h prior.

natalie: I'll own release notes + migration docs. Need a short compat matrix mapping old token types -> v2 claims. @sam @mia can you add a small table in your PRs?

sam: added initial table to infra/flags#78 and mock token generator for tests. One risk: customers with custom proxies that mutate headers. We should add a migration doc item for proxies and an example nginx snippet.

mia: found one edge: legacy refresh tokens use dots vs underscores in one tenant. Tests failing 2/17 with: ```ERROR: invalid token format at parseToken() line 212``` I can add a tolerant parser flag gated behind SDK 2.0 until customers migrate.

aj: Action items summary: (1) @mia finish SDK 2.0 and land #4523 by 2025-03-15, (2) @sam land flag toggle + migration script by 2025-03-20, (3) @olivia own canary + dashboards by 2025-03-22, (4) @natalie ship release notes & migration doc by 2025-03-24. If dates slip, call it out here. :calendar:

olivia: I'll add dashboards: auth.latency, auth.5xx, auth.token-fail-rate, plus a token-parsing-error rate. Will set alerts at 2x baseline for the canary.

mia: quick ask — can Dedicated keep a config `allow_legacy_auth` to avoid forcing on-prem customers to upgrade immediately? Sam?

sam: yes — adding `allow_legacy_auth: boolean` to config schema. Default false for new installs, migration script will flip to true for existing Dedicated instances. Will add an example CLI migration: ```./infra/migrate-config --set allow_legacy_auth=true --cluster dedicated-01```

aj: also code review pings — @mia please tag @olivia and @sam on PR comments for SDK PR. I'll coordinate with Product to update the external deprecation notice once canary is green. :shipit:

olivia: small legal/telemetry note — telemetry wants token payload sampling enabled for debugging during canary; legal approved sampled logs with redaction. @natalie can you add redaction guidance to the migration doc?

natalie: on it, will include sample redacted log entries and a checklist for customers.

aj: thanks! I'll post a short summary to #announcements after canary schedule and dashboards are confirmed. One more thing — quick runbook snippet for the canary toggle:

```bash
# enable canary variant, disable v1 fallback
./infra/deploy --cluster dedicated-01 --service auth --variant v2-auth --set allow_legacy_auth=false --duration 48h
```

aj: ping me if you need extra hands. If anyone hits scope creep, add it here and we'll triage. :warning:
